Does editing the price table (prices.json / SIGIL_MODEL_PRICES) after the fact change historical spend (it must NOT)? Does the spent() return-type change (Tuple[int,int] -> Spend) break any caller? Stamp it\n+            # onto the TAKEN record's payload so the spine stays the sole ledger (BudgetLedger derives\n+            # token/cost from exactly this datum). It composes the kill switch, budgets, and promotion policy into one fail-closed verdict:\n3\tAUTO (write it), QUEUE (hold for human approval), or DENY (refuse + log). Backward\n8\tcompatible: with no kill, no cap, and no promotion, A0/A1≤ceiling → AUTO and A2/A3 → QUEUE, exactly\n9\tas the pre-Phase-6 gate behaved.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n13\tfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n14\tfrom enum import Enum\n15\tfrom typing import Optional\n16\t\n17\tfrom .budget import BudgetCaps, BudgetLedger\n18\tfrom .killswitch import KillSwitch\n19\tfrom .promotion import PromotionPolicy\n20\t\n21\t\n22\tclass Outcome(Enum):\n23\t    AUTO = \"auto\"\n24\t    QUEUE = \"queue\"\n25\t    DENY = \"deny\"\n26\t\n27\t\n28\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n29\tclass Decision:\n30\t    outcome: Outcome\n31\t    reason: str\n32\t\n33\t\n34\tdef _utc_day() -> str:\n35\t    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()   # runtime bucketing only (never digested)\n36\t\n37\t\n38\tdef _load_caps() -> BudgetCaps:\n39\t    \"\"\"Optional per-agent caps from ~/.sigil/budgets.json ({daily_actions, daily_interrupts,\n40\t    daily_tokens, daily_cost_usd}). Absent/malformed → uncapped (budgets opt-in; default behavior\n41\t    unchanged — an old file with only the action/interrupt keys leaves token/cost None).\"\"\"\n42\t    try:\n43\t        import json\n44\t\n45\t        from ..config import SIGIL_HOME\n46\t        f = SIGIL_HOME / \"budgets.json\"\n47\t        if not f.exists():\n48\t            return BudgetCaps()\n49\t        d = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n50\t        return BudgetCaps(daily_actions=d.get(\"daily_actions\"), daily_interrupts=d.get(\"daily_interrupts\"),\n51\t                          daily_tokens=d.get(\"daily_tokens\"), daily_cost_usd=d.get(\"daily_cost_usd\"))\n52\t    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):\n53\t        return BudgetCaps()\n54\t\n55\t\n56\tclass Governor:\n57\t    def __init__(self, store, *, caps: Optional[BudgetCaps] = None, day_iso: Optional[str] = None,\n58\t                 owner_key=None, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n59\t        from .identity import owner_keypair, owner_pubkey\n60\t        self.store = store\n61\t        ok = owner_key if owner_key is not None else owner_keypair()\n62\t        tp = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n63\t        self.kill = KillSwitch(store, owner_key=ok, trusted_pubkey=tp)\n64\t        self.promo = PromotionPolicy(store, owner_key=ok, trusted_pubkey=tp)\n65\t        self.budget = BudgetLedger(store, caps if caps is not None else _load_caps())\n66\t        self._day = day_iso\n67\t\n68\t    def decide(self, *, agent: str, tier, ceiling, scope: Optional[str] = None) -> Decision:\n69\t        from ..agents.base import AUTO_BAR, Tier\n70\t        scope = scope or \"*\"\n71\t\n72\t        # A0 observe/read is ALWAYS allowed — even under a kill switch (perception + memory stay alive).\n73\t        if tier <= Tier.A0:\n74\t            return Decision(Outcome.AUTO, \"observe (A0)\")\n75\t\n76\t        # KILL SWITCH: the mesh is halted; nothing above observe may act.\n77\t        if self.kill.is_engaged():\n78\t            return Decision(Outcome.DENY, \"kill switch engaged — agent mesh halted (A0 observe only)\")\n79\t\n80\t        # BUDGET: fail-closed — at cap, deny.\n81\t        over, why = self.budget.over_budget(agent, self._day or _utc_day())\n82\t        if over:\n83\t            return Decision(Outcome.DENY, why)\n84\t\n85\t        # Within the auto bar (A0/A1) and the agent's ceiling → auto, as always.\n86\t        if tier <= AUTO_BAR and tier <= ceiling:\n87\t            return Decision(Outcome.AUTO, f\"within auto bar ({tier.label()})\")\n88\t\n89\t        # A2 may auto-approve ONLY under an explicit per-scope promotion (never for ENVOY).\n90\t        if tier == Tier.A2 and tier <= ceiling and self.promo.is_promoted(agent, scope):\n91\t            return Decision(Outcome.AUTO, f\"A2 auto-approved by promotion ({agent}/{scope})\")\n92\t\n93\t        # Everything else (A2 unpromoted, A3, or above ceiling) queues for explicit human approval.\n94\t        return Decision(Outcome.QUEUE, f\"queued for approval ({tier.label()})\")\n95\t"}]},"uuid":"d66285b2-7654-49c1-a9f5-d298acf99337","timestamp":"2026-07-19T20:19:39.866Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1bf56fa2-c9d6-4c5a-a50e-3ddeb5a6387d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"df887dec-ad0a-4977-973c-c81f501fd9e1","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"10bffc83-5221-4ad7-a40e-97315d84ba0f","agentId":"a7cf44bd4301e3bab","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Ho6q2KdQ2mrhbi86QsDpZK","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The SIGIL agent mesh framework (SIGIL §4/§5). Each agent has a MANDATE and an AUTONOMY\n2\tCEILING (A0–A3); everything it does is a `Proposal` carrying a tier. Proposals at or below the\n3\tauto bar (A1) and at or below the agent's ceiling are AUTO-APPLIED (written to the spine);\n4\tanything higher is QUEUED as a pending record a human must approve — never auto-executed.\n5\t\n6\tThe doctrine is enforced STRUCTURALLY, not by discipline: an agent literally cannot take an\n7\texternal-effect action, because no agent has a send/deploy/spend code path. ENVOY, in\n8\tparticular, drafts only — its ceiling is A2 and there is no method that transmits. Agent output\n9\tis provenance-linked spine records, so a brief or a draft is auditable back to what produced it.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n13\tfrom enum import IntEnum\n14\tfrom typing import TYPE_CHECKING, List, Optional\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n17\t\n18\tif TYPE_CHECKING:\n19\t    from ..governor.budget import Usage\n20\t\n21\tAGENTS_SOURCE = \"agent\"\n22\t\n23\t\n24\tclass Tier(IntEnum):\n25\t    \"\"\"Mirror of the WARDEN tiers (SIGIL §5), ordered so `<=` compares autonomy.\"\"\"\n26\t    A0 = 0   # observe / answer\n27\t    A1 = 1   # reversible internal act (write a report/brief/event) — the AUTO bar\n28\t    A2 = 2   # external-visible / semi-reversible (send, calendar write) — QUEUED\n29\t    A3 = 3   # destructive / financial / security — explicit, never auto\n30\t\n31\t    def label(self) -> str:\n32\t        return self.name\n33\t\n34\t\n35\tAUTO_BAR = Tier.A1  # A0/A1 auto-apply; A2/A3 queue for human approval\n36\t\n37\t\n38\t@dataclass\n39\tclass Proposal:\n40\t    \"\"\"One thing an agent wants to do: emit a record (auto) or take a gated action (queued).\"\"\"\n41\t    kind: str                       # spine record kind (event/finding/brief/interaction/draft/...)\n42\t    payload: dict\n43\t    tier: Tier = Tier.A1\n44\t    parent_id: Optional[int] = None\n45\t    supersedes_id: Optional[int] = None   # this record supersedes an earlier one (e.g. a resolution)\n46\t    usage: Optional[\"Usage\"] = None       # provider token/cost for this action (metered on the spine);\n47\t    # OPTIONAL — when None nothing is stamped and the record is byte-identical to the pre-metering path\n48\t\n49\t\n50\t@dataclass\n51\tclass AgentResult:\n52\t    agent: str\n53\t    applied: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)     # seqs written (auto)\n54\t    queued: List[dict] = field(default_factory=list)      # proposals held for approval\n55\t    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n56\t\n57\t\n58\tclass Agent:\n59\t    \"\"\"Base agent. Subclasses implement `run()`; the base routes every Proposal through the GOVERNOR\n60\t    (SIGIL §5: kill switch, budgets, promotion — Phase 6) and records the outcome on the spine.\n61\t    Backward compatible: with no kill/cap/promotion the governor reproduces the original gate.\"\"\"\n62\t    name: str = \"AGENT\"\n63\t    mandate: str = \"\"\n64\t    ceiling: Tier = Tier.A1\n65\t\n66\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, governor=None):\n67\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n68\t        if governor is None:\n69\t            from ..governor import Governor\n70\t            governor = Governor(self.store)\n71\t        self.governor = governor\n72\t\n73\t    def run(self) -> AgentResult:\n74\t        raise NotImplementedError\n75\t\n76\t    def _dispatch(self, proposals: List[Proposal]) -> AgentResult:\n77\t        from ..governor import Outcome\n78\t        res = AgentResult(agent=self.name)\n79\t        prices = None\n80\t        for p in proposals:\n81\t            effective = max(p.tier, Tier.A0)\n82\t            # promotion scope = the RECORD KIND (the real action written), not a self-asserted label:\n83\t            # a promotion is \"this agent may auto-approve A2 records of this kind\" (red-pen RP-3).\n84\t            decision = self.governor.decide(agent=self.name, tier=effective,\n85\t                                            ceiling=self.ceiling, scope=p.kind)\n86\t            common = {**p.payload, \"agent\": self.name, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n87\t                      \"governor\": decision.reason}\n88\t            # Metering seam (opt-in): a provider call may attach per-action token/cost usage. Stamp it\n89\t            # onto the TAKEN record's payload so the spine stays the sole ledger (BudgetLedger derives\n90\t            # token/cost from exactly this datum). Frozen once here; a denied action gets a refusal\n91\t            # record with NO usage below → it consumes no budget. No usage supplied → nothing stamped,\n92\t            # the record is byte-identical to the pre-metering path.\n93\t            if p.usage is not None:\n94\t                if prices is None:\n95\t                    from ..governor.budget import load_prices\n96\t                    prices = load_prices()\n97\t                common[\"usage\"] = p.usage.to_payload(prices)\n98\t            if decision.outcome == Outcome.AUTO:\n99\t                seq = self.store.append(kind=p.kind, source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n100\t                                        payload={**common, \"decision\": \"auto\"},\n101\t                                        parent_id=p.parent_id, supersedes_id=p.supersedes_id)\n102\t                res.applied.append(seq)\n103\t            elif decision.outcome == Outcome.QUEUE:\n104\t                seq = self.store.append(kind=p.kind, source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n105\t                                        payload={**common, \"decision\": \"queued\", \"status\": \"awaiting-approval\"},\n106\t                                        parent_id=p.parent_id, supersedes_id=p.supersedes_id)\n107\t                res.queued.append({\"seq\": seq, \"kind\": p.kind, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n108\t                                   \"subject\": p.payload.get(\"subject\") or p.payload.get(\"to\")})\n109\t            else:  # DENY — kill switch or budget; record the refusal, take no action\n110\t                self.store.append(kind=\"refusal\", source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n111\t                                  payload={\"agent\": self.name, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n112\t                                           \"decision\": \"denied\", \"governor\": decision.reason,\n113\t                                           \"of_kind\": p.kind, \"subject\": p.payload.get(\"subject\")},\n114\t                                  parent_id=p.parent_id)\n115\t                res.notes.append(f\"DENIED {p.kind} ({effective.label()}): {decision.reason}\")\n116\t        return res\n117\t"}]},"uuid":"00e40cdb-197f-4ff4-9ad1-41397aeb6d5f","timestamp":"2026-07-19T20:19:40.416Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"df887dec-ad0a-4977-973c-c81f501fd9e1","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"ef657871-8c8c-4586-828f-9180cc03c063","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"10bffc83-5221-4ad7-a40e-97315d84ba0f","agentId":"a7cf44bd4301e3bab","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UdBBAEG8eveikEv6x5My6C","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Per-agent daily budgets (SIGIL §5) — action, interrupt, and provider TOKEN + COST caps, enforced\n2\tFAIL-CLOSED (at/over cap → deny). The spine IS the ledger: every dimension is derived by scanning an\n3\tagent's own records for the UTC day, so there is no separate counter to drift or forge. Tokens and\n4\tcost live in the action record's payload (`payload[\"usage\"]`), stamped at dispatch WHEN a provider\n5\tcall supplied them — so `spent()` derives them exactly as it derives actions/interrupts. Caps default\n6\tto None (uncapped) → every dimension is opt-in and the default dispatch behavior is byte-identical\n7\tuntil a cap is set; a configured cap is hard-enforced.\n8\t\n9\tCost is FROZEN INTO THE RECORD at stamp time (from the price table below, or an explicit `cost_usd`),\n10\tnever re-derived at read time: the immutable spine is authoritative, so editing the price table never\n11\trewrites history. Token/cost were the documented seam in the action/interrupt-only version — this\n12\tcloses it without introducing a mutable counter. Tokens (input+output) are ALWAYS derivable from the\n13\tdatum; cost is best-effort (an unpriced model with no explicit `cost_usd` contributes 0 to the COST\n14\tmeter — its tokens still meter), so `daily_tokens` is the hard metering dimension and `daily_cost_usd`\n15\tis enforced against whatever cost the record froze.\"\"\"\n16\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n17\t\n18\timport math\n19\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n20\tfrom typing import Optional, Tuple\n21\t\n22\t# Default per-model prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, as (input, output). DATA, not policy — override\n23\t# or extend via ~/.sigil/prices.json or the SIGIL_MODEL_PRICES env (JSON), both merged OVER these. Keyed\n24\t# by model id and provider-agnostic (add any vendor's models the same way). The Anthropic rows are the\n25\t# published list prices as of 2026-06-24; `local` (Ollama / any fully-offline model) is $0. A model with\n26\t# no row (and no explicit cost_usd on its Usage) contributes 0 to the COST meter — its TOKENS still meter.\n27\tDEFAULT_PRICES: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {\n28\t    \"claude-fable-5\": (10.0, 50.0),\n29\t    \"claude-opus-4-8\": (5.0, 25.0),\n30\t    \"claude-opus-4-7\": (5.0, 25.0),\n31\t    \"claude-sonnet-5\": (3.0, 15.0),\n32\t    \"claude-sonnet-4-6\": (3.0, 15.0),\n33\t    \"claude-haiku-4-5\": (1.0, 5.0),\n34\t    \"local\": (0.0, 0.0),\n35\t}\n36\t\n37\t\n38\tdef _coerce_rate(v: object) -> Optional[tuple[float, float]]:\n39\t    \"\"\"A price-table row → an (input, output) per-MTok tuple. Accepts `[in, out]` / `(in, out)` or\n40\t    `{\"input\": in, \"output\": out}`; a malformed row is ignored (returns None) so a bad override file\n41\t    never silently zeroes a known model or crashes the gate.\"\"\"\n42\t    try:\n43\t        if isinstance(v, dict):\n44\t            return float(v[\"input\"]), float(v[\"output\"])\n45\t        if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) and len(v) == 2:\n46\t            return float(v[0]), float(v[1])\n47\t    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):\n48\t        return None\n49\t    return None\n50\t\n51\t\n52\tdef _merge_prices(dst: dict[str, tuple[float, float]], src: object) -> None:\n53\t    if not isinstance(src, dict):\n54\t        return\n55\t    for model, row in src.items():\n56\t        rate = _coerce_rate(row)\n57\t        if rate is not None and isinstance(model, str):\n58\t            dst[model] = rate\n59\t\n60\t\n61\tdef load_prices() -> dict[str, tuple[float, float]]:\n62\t    \"\"\"The active price table: DEFAULT_PRICES overlaid with ~/.sigil/prices.json and then the\n63\t    SIGIL_MODEL_PRICES env var (JSON), each a {model: [input_per_mtok, output_per_mtok]} map. Absent or\n64\t    malformed sources are ignored (prices are opt-in refinements; a bad file never crashes the gate or\n65\t    silently zeroes a known model).\"\"\"\n66\t    prices = dict(DEFAULT_PRICES)\n67\t    import json\n68\t    import os\n69\t    try:\n70\t        from ..config import SIGIL_HOME\n71\t        f = SIGIL_HOME / \"prices.json\"\n72\t        if f.exists():\n73\t            _merge_prices(prices, json.loads(f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")))\n74\t    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):\n75\t        pass\n76\t    raw = os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_MODEL_PRICES\")\n77\t    if raw:\n78\t        try:\n79\t            _merge_prices(prices, json.loads(raw))\n80\t        except ValueError:\n81\t            pass\n82\t    return prices\n83\t\n84\t\n85\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n86\tclass Usage:\n87\t    \"\"\"Provider token usage for ONE action, provider-agnostic. `cost_usd`, when None, is derived at\n88\t    stamp time from the price table for `model` (input+output × per-MTok rate); pass an explicit\n89\t    `cost_usd` to override (e.g. a metered invoice figure). `to_payload()` produces the datum recorded\n90\t    on the spine — the ONLY place token/cost live, so the ledger cannot be forged apart from the log.\n91\t    No secrets: only counts, a model id, and a number ever enter the payload.\"\"\"\n92\t    input_tokens: int = 0\n93\t    output_tokens: int = 0\n94\t    model: str = \"\"\n95\t    cost_usd: Optional[float] = None\n96\t\n97\t    def compute_cost(self, prices: Optional[dict[str, tuple[float, float]]] = None) -> float:\n98\t        \"\"\"USD cost of this action. An explicit `cost_usd` wins; otherwise price `model` from the table\n99\t        (input+output tokens × per-MTok rate). An unpriced model → 0.0 (tokens still meter).\"\"\"\n100\t        if self.cost_usd is not None:\n101\t            return float(self.cost_usd)\n102\t        table = prices if prices is not None else load_prices()\n103\t        rate = table.get(self.model)\n104\t        if rate is None:\n105\t            return 0.0\n106\t        in_rate, out_rate = rate\n107\t        return (self.input_tokens / 1_000_000.0) * in_rate + (self.output_tokens / 1_000_000.0) * out_rate\n108\t\n109\t    def to_payload(self, prices: Optional[dict[str, tuple[float, float]]] = None) -> dict:\n110\t        \"\"\"The immutable metering datum stamped into the action record's payload. Cost is frozen HERE,\n111\t        so a later price-table edit never rewrites past spend.\"\"\"\n112\t        return {\n113\t            \"input_tokens\": int(self.input_tokens),\n114\t            \"output_tokens\": int(self.output_tokens),\n115\t            \"model\": self.model,\n116\t            \"cost_usd\": round(self.compute_cost(prices), 6),\n117\t        }\n118\t\n119\t\n120\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n121\tclass Spend:\n122\t    \"\"\"What an agent has spent today, every field derived from the spine (never a stored counter).\n123\t    `tokens` is input+output summed; `cost_usd` is the sum of the frozen per-record costs.\"\"\"\n124\t    actions: int = 0\n125\t    interrupts: int = 0\n126\t    tokens: int = 0\n127\t    cost_usd: float = 0.0\n128\t\n129\t\n130\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n131\tclass BudgetCaps:\n132\t    daily_actions: Optional[int] = None       # max records an agent may write per UTC day\n133\t    daily_interrupts: Optional[int] = None    # max A1 events/alerts (the noise budget) per UTC day\n134\t    daily_tokens: Optional[int] = None        # max provider tokens (input+output) per UTC day\n135\t    daily_cost_usd: Optional[float] = None    # max provider spend in USD per UTC day\n136\t\n137\t\n138\tdef _as_int(v: object) -> int:\n139\t    \"\"\"Defensive coercion for a value read off the spine — a forged/hand-written usage datum must not\n140\t    crash the enforcement path (mirrors the spine reader's skip-malformed posture): junk → 0. Also\n141\t    catches OverflowError so a forged non-finite float (JSON accepts `Infinity`) can't raise here.\"\"\"\n142\t    if isinstance(v, (int, float, str)):\n143\t        try:\n144\t            return int(v)\n145\t        except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):\n146\t            return 0\n147\t    return 0\n148\t\n149\t\n150\tdef _as_float(v: object) -> float:\n151\t    \"\"\"As `_as_int`, and additionally maps a non-finite value (NaN/±inf) to 0.0 — otherwise a forged\n152\t    NaN cost would sum to NaN and slip the `cost >= cap` check (fail-open); this keeps it fail-closed.\"\"\"\n153\t    if isinstance(v, (int, float, str)):\n154\t        try:\n155\t            f = float(v)\n156\t        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n157\t            return 0.0\n158\t        return f if math.isfinite(f) else 0.0\n159\t    return 0.0\n160\t\n161\t\n162\tclass BudgetLedger:\n163\t    def __init__(self, store, caps: Optional[BudgetCaps] = None):\n164\t        self.store = store\n165\t        self.caps = caps or BudgetCaps()\n166\t\n167\t    def spent(self, agent: str, day_iso: str) -> Spend:\n168\t        \"\"\"Today's spend for `agent`: actions, interrupt events, tokens (input+output), and USD cost —\n169\t        all counted from the agent's own records for the UTC date `day_iso` (the ts is informational,\n170\t        so bucketing is by wallclock date). Token/cost come from `payload[\"usage\"]`, derived the SAME\n171\t        way as actions so there is nothing separate to drift or forge.\"\"\"\n172\t        actions = interrupts = tokens = 0\n173\t        cost = 0.0\n174\t        for r in self.store.iter_records():\n175\t            if r.source != \"agent\" or r.actor != agent:\n176\t                continue\n177\t            if not (r.ts or \"\").startswith(day_iso):\n178\t                continue\n179\t            # count only actions actually TAKEN (auto/queued) — a denial consumes no budget, so a flood\n180\t            # of denied attempts can't self-reinforce the cap. A denied record carries no `usage` (the\n181\t            # refusal record has none), so this same gate keeps token/cost fail-closed too.\n182\t            if r.payload.get(\"decision\") not in (\"auto\", \"queued\"):\n183\t                continue\n184\t            actions += 1\n185\t            if r.kind == \"event\":\n186\t                interrupts += 1\n187\t            u = r.payload.get(\"usage\")\n188\t            if isinstance(u, dict):\n189\t                tokens += _as_int(u.get(\"input_tokens\")) + _as_int(u.get(\"output_tokens\"))\n190\t                cost += _as_float(u.get(\"cost_usd\"))\n191\t        return Spend(actions=actions, interrupts=interrupts, tokens=tokens, cost_usd=cost)\n192\t\n193\t    def over_budget(self, agent: str, day_iso: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:\n194\t        \"\"\"Fail-closed: at/over ANY configured cap → (True, reason). All caps None → never over (opt-in;\n195\t        default dispatch unchanged). A denied action wrote no `usage`, so it never advances the meter.\"\"\"\n196\t        caps = self.caps\n197\t        if (caps.daily_actions is None and caps.daily_interrupts is None\n198\t                and caps.daily_tokens is None and caps.daily_cost_usd is None):\n199\t            return False, \"\"\n200\t        s = self.spent(agent, day_iso)\n201\t        if caps.daily_actions is not None and s.actions >= caps.daily_actions:\n202\t            return True, f\"daily action cap ({caps.daily_actions}) reached for {agent}\"\n203\t        if caps.daily_interrupts is not None and s.interrupts >= caps.daily_interrupts:\n204\t            return True, f\"daily interrupt cap ({caps.daily_interrupts}) reached for {agent}\"\n205\t        if caps.daily_tokens is not None and s.tokens >= caps.daily_tokens:\n206\t            return True, f\"daily token cap ({caps.daily_tokens}) reached for {agent}\"\n207\t        if caps.daily_cost_usd is not None and s.cost_usd >= caps.daily_cost_usd:\n208\t            return True, f\"daily cost cap (${caps.daily_cost_usd:g}) reached for {agent}\"\n209\t        return False, \"\"\n210\t\n211\t    def report(self, day_iso: str) -> dict[str, dict]:\n212\t        \"\"\"Per-agent {actions, interrupts, tokens, cost_usd} for `day_iso` (UTC date prefix) — the\n213\t        read-only view behind `sigil budget`. Single spine scan; counts only actions actually TAKEN\n214\t        (auto/queued), mirroring the enforced ledger, so a denial never inflates the report.\"\"\"\n215\t        out: dict[str, dict] = {}\n216\t        for r in self.store.iter_records():\n217\t            if r.source != \"agent\":\n218\t                continue\n219\t            if not (r.ts or \"\").startswith(day_iso):\n220\t                continue\n221\t            if r.payload.get(\"decision\") not in (\"auto\", \"queued\"):\n222\t                continue\n223\t            a = out.setdefault(r.actor, {\"actions\": 0, \"interrupts\": 0, \"tokens\": 0, \"cost_usd\": 0.0})\n224\t            a[\"actions\"] += 1\n225\t            if r.kind == \"event\":\n226\t                a[\"interrupts\"] += 1\n227\t            u = r.payload.get(\"usage\")\n228\t            if isinstance(u, dict):\n229\t                a[\"tokens\"] += _as_int(u.get(\"input_tokens\")) + _as_int(u.get(\"output_tokens\"))\n230\t                a[\"cost_usd\"] += _as_float(u.get(\"cost_usd\"))\n231\t        for a in out.values():\n232\t            a[\"cost_usd\"] = round(a[\"cost_usd\"], 6)\n233\t        return out\n234\t"}]},"uuid":"87b022e1-28b1-4b6a-8d49-5c91919d7755","timestamp":"2026-07-19T20:19:40.418Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ef657871-8c8c-4586-828f-9180cc03c063","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

So a record with negative `input_tokens`/`cost_usd` cancels real spend. The meter is not monotonic; an agent zeroes it at will.\n\nConcrete, run through the real `Governor.over_budget`/`spent`:\n- Caps `daily_tokens=1000`, `daily_cost_usd=$1.00`.\n- Agent interleaves each real 900-token/$0.90 action with a forged \"accounting\" record `Usage(input_tokens=-900, cost_usd=-0.90)`. The negative datum is reachable both by a hand-forged spine record (the spine-as-ledger threat) and by any caller constructing a `Usage` with negative fields; it also silently erases spend on any benign future correction/refund record.
